reviews.title: Great Power Supply at a great price!
reviews.comment: After having a new MSI ATX3.1 power supply blow and take out have my components I decided to try this Red Dragon power supply and I have to say I am beyond impressed. The build quality is excellent and at first I thought the ARGB fan was just a gimmick, but it comes through on the back of my daughters Lian Li 011D case and looks awesome. Also Red Dragon includes a power supply tester and MSI does not, which would have been nice to have. The cables are not the highest quality I have ever seen, they are good and work just fine though. Overall this power supply compares very well to my Corsair RM1000x. While the Corsair has better cables, both power supplies generally are very close on all other features. Both use Japanese CAPs, both are quiet and considering the Red Dragon power supply was considerably cheaper I would have to lean towards the Red Dragon if I ever need another power supply. Really, you can't go wrong with this power supply.
reviews.author: ArcAngel

reviews.title: It works, and is pretty.
reviews.comment: It works fine, fit perfectly with what I bought it for. I just wanted a good power supply and the RGB is a bonus, I’m happy I did because with the case I got it for, it shows off the LED really well. Ignore the Power LED flashing I must’ve not seated the cable for that all the way.

reviews.title: Worth the price. Easy install
reviews.comment: Stress tested and no issues raised with it. Fits right into my musetex case with no issue. Came with all of the cables I needed and frankly they didn't feel cheap. The RGB is direct and you have no control over it aside a button that changes the colors and modes. For 80 bucks a psu that has 5 years of warranty. Gotta love it

reviews.title: It works very well and look amazing.
reviews.comment: The card works well all tough i was having troubles with it but the support system was really well and helped me get it fixed and it works great sense they’ve helped me. It’s really quiet I can’t hear it whatsoever. It’s very bright and colorful. It was installed easily really fast and short cables. It it good on cooling I highly recommend this product.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.comment: Received the product today with great anticipation, however; the product did not work. It failed to power on and you could hear tiny moving parts rattling on the inside. I’m not sure if this company has a quality control but, they really need one. Update 11/27/22: After returning the psu, a customer service rep reached out to me and sent me a new psu. Glad to say the one they sent works as advertised! It has about 6 light modes from various colors to rainbow. I am giving this product a 4 star rating purely based off of the initial experience otherwise it would be 5 stars.
